question: Compare the warranty requirements of both bids.
answer:
Bid1: Dallas ISD is asking for a one-year warranty for student Chromebooks and three years for student and staff Windows laptops. All warranties to be made by OEM.
Bid2: Warranty extended for all machines purchased is 3 years following the date of delivery. Warranty certificate or affidavit to be presented upon award.
warranty period: cited statements differ between Bid1, Bid2.
